height_encoding: metres = min + value / 65535 * (max - min); rows run north to south, columns west to east
note: metre-scale relief is below the product's vertical precision: the simulation adds procedural detail on top
licence: public domain (https://lroc.im-ldi.com/about/terms); credit NASA/GSFC/Arizona State University
site_basis: chosen with the criteria of Flahaut et al. 2024 (Space Sci. Rev. 220:53): >=95% of slopes under 15 deg, mean slope <=7.3 deg at 8 m cells, nearest to prime ellipse FR-11
height_quantisation: low 4 bits of the 16 bit value zeroed (about 8 cm steps)
